story_type: litter hoist from a fishing boat offshore, heart attack symptoms
hook: 65 miles out, his heart was giving out.
narration: Sixty-five miles off Virginia Beach, a man on this fishing boat was having symptoms of a heart attack.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew came in over the boat and lowered a rescue litter to the deck.
A litter keeps a patient lying flat and strapped in, so he never has to sit up or hold on during the lift.
The flight mechanic guided it up toward the open door while the boat kept moving below.
Then the crew pulled the litter inside.
outcome: The aircrew hoisted him aboard and flew him to Sentara Hospital in Norfolk for care.

location_card.place: 65 miles east of Virginia Beach, Va.

title: Heart attack 65 miles off Virginia
description:
On Aug. 21, 2021, a Coast Guard helicopter crew hoisted a 46-year-old man with heart attack symptoms off a fishing boat about 65 miles east of Virginia Beach and flew him to a hospital in Norfolk.
